# Lab 21.5: Query Queues & Target Concurrency

## What We Are Going to Do
Limit how many queries run at once in a reservation, and watch extra queries wait in the queue.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a reservation with low concurrency.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --reservation --location=US --edition=STANDARD --slots=0 --autoscale_max_slots=50 --concurrency=2 lab-queue
bq mk --reservation_assignment --reservation_id=$PROJECT_ID:US.lab-queue \
  --job_type=QUERY --assignee_type=PROJECT --assignee_id=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Start 6 queries at once.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">for i in $(seq 1 6); do
  bq query --nosync --use_legacy_sql=false --nouse_cache \
    'SELECT company, APPROX_QUANTILES(fare, 100) FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` GROUP BY company'
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] See running vs queued.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT job_id, state, creation_time, start_time
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
ORDER BY creation_time;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   About 2 jobs are `RUNNING`; the rest are `PENDING` (queued).

4. **[Console] Watch the queue.** **Monitoring → Job concurrency** shows pending jobs for the reservation.

5. **[CLI] Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq rm --reservation_assignment $(bq ls --reservation_assignment --location=US --format=json | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]['name'])")
bq rm --reservation --location=US lab-queue</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Target concurrency | 2 running at a time |
| Extra queries | Wait in the queue |
| Default | BigQuery sets concurrency automatically |
| Use | Protect performance of each query |
